steps.rule: Tier A prefers authored mode; Tier B uses procedural unless explicitly authored; Tier C may remain latent.
Choose from species-agnostic recipe library. Species alone never selects personality.
Apply deterministic variation to recipe anchors and fill unspecified dimensions inside allowed bands.
If the NPC was previously seen/spoken to, keep the resolved profile compatible with recorded behavior.
Apply actual culture/upbringing/institution modifiers as expression/socialization layers; never overwrite core identity.
Bind unique personality_profile_id to entity_id permanently.
At conversation time combine core + culture expression + relationship + current state + scene constraints.

procedural_uniqueness.note: Two NPCs can share an abstract recipe while differing in scalar values, secondary tags, history, culture, relationships and current state.

tier_transitions.C_to_B: Resolve once from latent seed plus observed constraints; irreversible.
tier_transitions.B_to_A: Deepen or author around established personality; no reroll.
tier_transitions.A_to_other: Narrative importance may change but personality identity remains.
